import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',f); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def grid(h,w,pts):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=2
    return g
def expected_from_marks(h,w,twos,threes):
    g=grid(h,w,twos)
    for r,c in threes:g[r][c]=3
    return g
# Pair 1, row/col indices are zero based
p1=[(3,8),(6,4),(6,12),(9,10),(11,7)]
t1=[(4,8),(5,8)]+[(6,c) for c in range(5,12)]+[(r,7) for r in (7,8,9,10)]+[(r,10) for r in (7,8)]
# Pair 2
p2=[(2,5),(6,2),(7,10),(10,8),(12,5)]
t2=[(r,5) for r in range(3,12)]+[(6,c) for c in range(3,5)]+[(7,c) for c in range(6,10)]+[(10,c) for c in range(6,8)]
for idx,(h,w,pts,ths) in enumerate([(19,13,p1,t1),(16,12,p2,t2)],1):
    actual=mod.transform(grid(h,w,pts)); expected=expected_from_marks(h,w,pts,ths)
    print('demo',idx,'match',actual==expected)
    if actual!=expected:
        print([(r,c,actual[r][c],expected[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if actual[r][c]!=expected[r][c]])
test=grid(14,17,[(3,6),(6,4),(8,1),(8,12),(10,10),(12,8)])
out=mod.transform(test)
print('OUTPUT')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
